items.kind: 需決策＋需準備（要不要投；GPA／英檢／推薦要提早備齊）

items.en: Trump Says US Navy Has 'Full Control' of Hormuz as Iran Issues New Demands to Reopen the Strait
items.zh: 川普稱美軍已完全控制荷姆茲海峽，伊朗同日拋出重啟海峽的新條件
items.summary: President Trump said Monday the United States has swept the Strait of Hormuz for mines and that the US Navy now has full control of the waterway. Hours earlier, the secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council issued a list of conditions for reopening the strait: lift the naval blockade and sanctions, withdraw US forces, pay war reparations and release frozen Iranian assets. An IRGC spokesman said reopening was not imminent and depends on Washington accepting Iran's terms in full. The strait carries roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne crude, so the standoff feeds directly into Asian import costs.

items.en: Iran Shakes Up Military Leadership as Strait of Hormuz Talks Appear to Stall
items.zh: 荷姆茲談判停滯之際，伊朗大幅改組軍事領導層
items.summary: Iran reshuffled senior military commanders on Monday as negotiations over a shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz lost momentum over the weekend. Tehran's foreign minister said a temporary deal with Oman allowing a limited route was close, but insisted Iran still expects substantial control over the waterway. The leadership change is read by analysts as either preparation for a longer confrontation or an attempt to consolidate authority before concessions. Progress reportedly stalled after Iran raised new demands and Houthi forces struck a Red Sea port.

items.en: UAE Condemns Attack on Tanker Linked to Its State Oil Company in the Strait
items.zh: 阿聯譴責其國家石油公司關聯油輪在海峽遭攻擊
items.summary: The United Arab Emirates condemned what it described as an Iranian attack on a carrier linked to its state oil company as the vessel transited the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend. The incident, alongside a Houthi strike on a Red Sea port, undercut the tentative optimism from last week when Washington had signalled a reopening was near. Shipping insurers have responded by widening war-risk premiums across Gulf routes again, a cost that flows through to importers in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea even when headline crude prices move only modestly.

items.en: Brent Crude Jumps Back Above $86 as the Geopolitical Risk Premium Returns
items.zh: 布蘭特原油重返 86 美元以上，地緣風險溢價再度回鍋
items.summary: Brent crude climbed past $86 a barrel on Monday, wiping out most of last week's slide, after progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz stalled. The United States Oil Fund rose 5.9% on the session. Crude has now travelled from $113 in the spring to near $80 last week and back to $86, a loop that has repeated three times in three weeks as negotiations advance and then break down. The timing matters: the move lands two days before Wednesday's US Consumer Price Index report, where forecasters expect headline inflation of 3.4% versus 3.5% in June.

items.en: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Has Withheld Forward Guidance for Two Straight Meetings
items.zh: 新任聯準會主席華許連續兩次會議拒絕給出前瞻指引
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has now declined to offer forward guidance at two consecutive policy meetings, a break from more than a decade of Fed communication practice. Warsh said last week the central bank has 'no tolerance' for inflation, a remark that sent the Dow down 840 points on 6 August. Without guidance, markets are pricing rate expectations off incoming data alone, which is why Wednesday's CPI print carries unusual weight. For equity investors the practical effect is higher day-to-day volatility around each data release.

items.en: Nvidia Slides 3% on Reports It May Cut Back HBM in a Coming AI Accelerator Design
items.zh: 傳輝達下一代 AI 加速器將減少 HBM 用量以保護毛利，股價單日重挫 3%
items.summary: Nvidia fell 3.1% to $217.07 on Monday, shedding roughly $104 billion in market value, after reports suggested the company may reduce high-bandwidth memory content in an upcoming AI accelerator design to protect margins. HBM is among the most expensive components in an AI GPU. Notably, Micron closed essentially flat at $876.23, down just 0.15%, suggesting Wall Street is not buying the bear case for memory suppliers. The broader iShares Semiconductor ETF fell 1.7% and SK Hynix dropped 1.7%, while Microsoft rose 1.6% and Amazon added 1.1%.

items.en: AI Model Race Has No Clear Winner as Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini Diverge
items.zh: AI 模型競賽首次沒有明確贏家：Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini 各走各的路
items.summary: For the first time since the original ChatGPT launch, analysts say there is no single leader in the frontier model race. Anthropic has deployed Claude Opus 5, positioned near the intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at roughly half the price, after regulators lifted a June export-control order that had pulled its flagship offline for nearly three weeks. OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna pricing by 80% to $0.20/$1.20 per million tokens on 30 July and Terra by 20%. Google continues to push Gemini into its consumer surfaces. Price, not raw capability, is now the main competitive lever.

items.en: Nasdaq Approves 23-Hour Trading, Leaving Just One Hour of Daily Downtime
items.zh: 那斯達克拍板「23 小時交易」，一天只休市 1 小時
items.summary: Nasdaq has approved a move to a 23-hour trading day, leaving only a single hour of downtime for settlement and maintenance. The change is aimed at overseas investors, particularly in Asia, who currently trade US equities in thin overnight sessions with wide spreads. For Taiwanese retail investors the practical effect is that US positions can be adjusted during Taipei daytime hours rather than after midnight, but liquidity in the extended windows is expected to remain far below the regular session, so slippage risk on market orders stays elevated.

items.en: European Athletics Championships Open in Birmingham for a Seven-Day Run
items.zh: 歐洲田徑錦標賽在伯明罕開幕，賽期七天
items.summary: The European Athletics Championships began on 10 August in Birmingham, England, and run through 16 August. It is the marquee track event of a crowded August calendar that also includes the restart of the Formula 1 and MotoGP seasons and the Vuelta a Espana. The championships serve as a form guide ahead of the next global championship cycle, and several sprint and distance finals are scheduled for the closing weekend. For viewers in Asia most finals fall in the late evening Taipei time.

items.en: National Bank Open Reaches Its Final Stages as the Cincinnati Open Begins
items.zh: 加拿大大師賽進入尾聲，辛辛那提大師賽今日開打
items.summary: The National Bank Open, with the men's draw in Montreal and the women's in Toronto, is in its closing rounds after starting on 1 August and finishing on 13 August. The Cincinnati Open follows immediately, opening on 11 August and running to 23 August. The two hard-court events form the main run-up to the US Open, and the compressed calendar means several top seeds will play back-to-back tournaments with minimal rest, a scheduling complaint players have raised repeatedly this season.

items.en: Premier League Preseason Winds Down Before the 21 August Opener
items.zh: 英超季前賽收尾，新球季 8/21 開踢
items.summary: Premier League clubs are in the final week of preseason friendlies ahead of the 2026-27 campaign. The season opens on Friday 21 August with defending champions Arsenal hosting Championship winners Coventry City, preceded by the FA Community Shield on 16 August between Arsenal and Manchester City. In the United States the NFL preseason is already underway, having opened with the Hall of Fame Game between the Carolina Panthers and Arizona Cardinals on 6 August.

items.en: Teen Cannabis Use Linked to Slower Growth in Memory, Attention and Processing Speed
items.zh: 研究：青少年使用大麻與記憶、注意力、處理速度成長變慢有關
items.summary: A study published on 7 August reports that adolescents who begin using cannabis show slower growth in memory, attention, language and processing speed. The pattern is notable because these abilities often developed normally at first and then began levelling off, while non-users continued improving. The finding points to a divergence in developmental trajectory rather than an immediate deficit, which researchers say is easy to miss in short-term studies. The work adds to evidence that adolescence is a particularly sensitive window for cognitive development.

items.en: Brain's Memory Centre Undergoes a Hidden Immune Shift Beginning Around Age 50
items.zh: 研究發現大腦記憶中樞約在 50 歲出現隱藏的免疫細胞轉換
items.summary: Researchers reported on 6 August that beginning around age 50 the brain's memory centre appears to lose many of its long-resident immune cells and replace them with more inflammatory ones. The shift is subtle and occurs in people ageing normally, which is why it had gone largely unnoticed. Investigators suggest it may help explain how ordinary ageing sets the stage for Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, and it opens a possible intervention window decades before symptoms appear.

items.en: CNN Documentary Examines How Performance Enhancement Went Mainstream
items.zh: CNN 紀錄片：增強表現的藥物如何從競技場走進日常
items.summary: CNN announced on 10 August that The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper will air 'Stacked: Inside the Enhancement Craze' on 16 August, reported by Isobel Yeung. The film argues that enhancement has moved far beyond elite competition into a mainstream industry backed by billionaire investors and amplified by social media algorithms. The psychological angle is the interesting one for students: the programme examines how body-image feedback loops on social platforms drive uptake among young men in particular.

items.en: HBM3E Contract Prices Rise About 20% Quarter-on-Quarter as 2026 Capacity Is Booked Out
items.zh: HBM3E 合約價季增約 20%，2026 年產能已被 AI 加速器需求訂滿
items.summary: HBM3E contract pricing rose roughly 20% quarter-on-quarter as SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron allocate their 2026 capacity against already-booked AI accelerator demand. TSMC has committed an additional $100 billion to US manufacturing, bringing its total commitment to $265 billion, and confirmed 2026 capital expenditure at the high end of its $52-56 billion guidance, directly funding CoWoS and advanced-node wafer capacity. Nvidia's Rubin chips will be built by TSMC on a 3nm process using HBM4, scheduled for the third quarter of 2026.

items.en: SK Hynix Deepens Packaging Partnership With TSMC and Builds Out Cheongju M15X
items.zh: SK 海力士深化與台積電封裝合作，並加速興建清州 M15X 廠
items.summary: SK Hynix has strengthened its advanced-packaging partnership with TSMC while building the Cheongju M15X fab and setting up a dedicated HBM organisation with global production infrastructure. The company's own 2026 outlook describes an HBM-led memory supercycle. The read-through for Taiwan is direct: advanced packaging and CoWoS capacity is the bottleneck in the AI accelerator chain, and Taiwanese suppliers in substrate, thermal and testing sit on the same critical path.

items.en: Two-Photon Interference Demonstrated Between Atomic Vapour and a Quantum Dot
items.zh: 量子點與原子蒸氣間首次實現雙光子干涉，混合量子網路再進一步
items.summary: Researchers from Pusan National University and UNIST demonstrated direct two-photon interference between two fundamentally different quantum light sources: a warm caesium atomic vapour and a semiconductor quantum dot. Interfacing dissimilar platforms has been a long-standing obstacle to hybrid quantum networking, because atomic systems store information well while semiconductor sources emit quickly. Bridging them is a prerequisite for practical quantum repeaters. The result is early-stage laboratory work, not a product, but it removes a specific technical objection.

items.en: Official HIGE DANdism Brings Its 2026 Asia Tour to Taipei on 29-30 August
items.zh: Official髭男dism 2026 亞洲巡迴台北場，8/29–8/30 台北南港小巨蛋 ★ 只剩兩週半
items.summary: Official HIGE DANdism will play the Taipei stop of its 2026 Asia Tour on 29 and 30 August at the Taipei Nangang Small Dome (Nanjing East Road Section 4, No. 2, Songshan District), with both shows starting at 18:00. Tickets are handled through the Kham ticketing system. This is the nearest of any date on your artist list, now under three weeks away, and it lands right before the semester starts on the first week of September. If you want to go, check remaining inventory this week rather than later.  Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/search/Official%20HIGE%20DANdism
items.source: 波麗佳音娛樂 PONY CANYON in TAIWAN

items.en: Fujii Kaze Announces Prema World Tour Stop in Kaohsiung on 31 October
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 高雄場 10/31 國家體育場，香港場待公布
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour includes a Kaohsiung date on 31 October 2026 at 19:00 at the Kaohsiung National Stadium, with tickets having gone on sale through KKTIX from 20 June. The Asian leg also covers Fukuoka, Osaka, Tokyo, Bangkok and Seoul, with European and North American dates to follow. A Hong Kong show is confirmed for 2026 but the date and venue have not been announced. The Kaohsiung venue is an outdoor stadium, so it is a large-capacity show rather than an arena date.  Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/search/Fujii%20Kaze

items.en: Vaundy Sets Taipei Dates for 31 October and 1 November, Hong Kong on 3 October
items.zh: Vaundy 首次海外個唱巡迴「HORO」：台北 10/31–11/1、香港 10/3 ★ 與藤井風高雄場同日
items.summary: Vaundy's first overseas solo tour, HORO, will play the Taipei Nangang Small Dome on 31 October and 1 November 2026, with the Hong Kong stop on Saturday 3 October at the AsiaWorld-Expo Arena. Note the clash: Vaundy's first Taipei night falls on exactly the same day as Fujii Kaze's Kaohsiung stadium show on 31 October, so those two are mutually exclusive unless you take the Taipei show on 1 November instead. Both are on your tracked artist list.  Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/search/Vaundy

items.en: King Gnu Releases 'GO GHOST' as the Ghost in the Shell Opening Theme
items.zh: King Gnu 新單曲〈GO GHOST〉成為《攻殼機動隊》主題曲
items.summary: King Gnu released a new single titled 'GO GHOST', used as the opening theme for the new Ghost in the Shell series. It appeared in the early-August J-pop release cycle. No Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan tour dates tied to the single have been announced yet, so for now this is a streaming-only item. Elsewhere in the same release week, suisoh put out 'CERAMIC SKIN', her first solo release in over a year, and Tommy heavenly6 returned with her first material under that name since 2018. market.note: 昨天兩邊完全走反方向，而且原因不一樣。台股 8/10 大漲 702.85 點收 44,928.76（+1.59%），量能放大到 8,473.72 億，外資買超 517 億、三大法人同步站多方——這是 8/7 賣超 442 億後的急轉彎。推力有三個：① MSCI 成分股卡位潮＋DRAM／NAND 報價看漲，南亞科與華邦電雙雙強鎖漲停、合計吸金逾 700 億；② 台達電漲停 +165 元收 1,815，單檔就撐起大盤逾百點，加上川湖等 6 檔千金齊亮燈；③ 傳台積電有意向面板廠購地，友達、群創開盤半小時漲停爆量。但要注意「45K 得而復失」——盤中最高衝到 45,219 卻收在 44,928，尾盤台積電甚至遭甩賣，追高的位置並不便宜。反觀美股 8/10 三大指數全數小跌（S&P -0.11%、道瓊 -0.19%、那斯達克 -0.46%），走的是「原地踏步」的盤：微軟 +1.6%、亞馬遜 +1.1% 撐住，輝達 -3.1%、蘋果 -2.4% 砍下來，兩邊互相抵銷。輝達的利空是「下一代 AI 加速器可能減少 HBM 用量以保護毛利」——這條新聞對台股記憶體族群理論上是利空，但台股 8/10 完全沒理會（因為台股收盤時美股還沒開），今天開盤就是第一次面對這個時間差。
market.highlight: ⚠️ 三件今天開盤前務必先想清楚的事：① 時間差風險——台股 8/10 記憶體漲停行情發生在美股「輝達傳砍 HBM」利空之前，而美光 8/10 卻幾乎平盤（-0.15%），代表華爾街不買空方帳；今天台股記憶體族群是續強還是回吐，是最大觀察點，追高前先看南亞科／華邦電的開盤五檔有沒有排隊。② 油價回到 86 美元以上（USO +5.93%），荷姆茲談判再度破局，華航 8/10 已先跌 9.11%；8/12（明天）美國 CPI 公布，預估 3.4%，而聯準會新主席華許已連兩次會議拒絕給前瞻指引，數據一出來波動會被放大。③ 資金明顯從矽晶圓輪出（台勝科 -9.44%）轉進記憶體與被動元件，處置股新制 8/10 上路後禾伸堂、南電提前解禁，這類「解禁跳空」的行情通常只有 1–2 天，別當成趨勢追。
